Subject: BetaCloud pilot - onboarding and PO requirement clarification

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our product team is excited to run a short pilot with BetaCloud (30 days, proof-of-concept). Before we kick off, procurement asked me to confirm whether you require a Redwood PO for vendor setup or if you can accept invoice-only billing for this initial engagement.

Attached is the SOW for the pilot (SOW-beta-pilot.docx). Total estimated amount for the pilot is ~$8,500. If a PO is required on your side, can you share a sample PO format and any lead time we should account for? If an exception is possible for this small pilot, please let me know what you need us to provide to get approval.

Quick asks:
- Can BetaCloud accept invoice-only billing for this one-off pilot?
- If not, what is your PO lead time and any required fields?

Appreciate a fast turnaround — hope to start next week.

Thanks,
Jonas

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: BetaCloud pilot - onboarding and PO requirement clarification

Jonas —

Thanks for flagging. Quick summary of Redwood's current vendor policy (short):
- Standard: PO required for all vendor relationships for services or recurring payments. POs support AP automation and cost-center routing.
- Exception path: Procurement can approve a one-time no-PO invoice for amounts < $10k on a case-by-case basis if the business owner (you) provides:
  - Completed vendor onboarding form (W-9 / tax info if US vendor)
  - Signed SOW or contract specifying scope and amount
  - Approval from Finance (Marcus) for the no-PO exception

I'll attach the vendor onboarding template and the checklist. Please have BetaCloud complete the onboarding form and provide a W-9 (or appropriate tax form). Also confirm the exact remittance details they want to use.

If you want, I can prep the exception memo once you confirm the pilot amount. Assuming documentation is in order, procurement will triage and aim to approve within 48 hours.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_template.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@betacloud.io>

Hi Jonas —

Great to hear you want to move forward. BetaCloud can work with either flow but a couple notes:
- Our standard customer onboarding for enterprise accounts uses POs but for small, short pilots we frequently accept invoice-only and Net 30 payment.
- If Redwood requires a PO on your side, we can consume it; typical turnaround on our end for issuing a PO (if requested) is 5–7 business days because it routes through our legal/procurement.

I've attached a short exception request packet we use when customers prefer invoice-only for pilot work (betacloud_po-exception-request.pdf). For the one-off pilot you'll need:
- Signed SOW (you provided)
- Completed onboarding form (we can accept Redwood's form or BetaCloud's)
- Agreement on payment terms (Net 30 acceptable)

If you can route the onboarding form and a confirmatory approval from finance, we'll proceed on invoice terms.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships | BetaCloud Inc.
samira.khan@betacloud.io
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BetaCloud pilot - onboarding and PO requirement clarification

Jonas —

Appreciate the context and the SOW. Approving a one-time no-PO invoice for this pilot is acceptable under these conditions:
1) Pilot total <= $10,000 (this stated amount $8,500 is fine).
2) A signed SOW is on file (SOW-beta-pilot.docx).
3) Completed vendor onboarding form with tax/remit details (attach to AP ticket).
4) AP must receive the invoice referencing AP ticket AP-8721 and the correct GL/chartstring provided by the business owner.

Please have BetaCloud complete the onboarding form and send their invoice to ap@redwood.ai with the AP ticket in the subject. Once AP has the invoice + supporting docs, we'll process payment Net 30. This approval is for this single pilot only — any expansion or recurring contract must go through standard PO issuance.

-Marcus
VP, Finance Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
